title: My Daughter Forged A Letter, Stole My $1.1M Deal. So I Proved Forgery And Now She Works For Me
description: I emptied my $85,000 401(k) to start an indie publishing house with my daughter and secured a 30% lifetime royalty. She forged a rights-reversion letter, sold a viral memoir for $1.1 million, and mailed me a $5,000 check. I retrieved our original contract, proved the forgery via metadata, and now she stuffs envelopes for me in a 'Plot Twist: I Stole from Mom' shirt. #ForensicAccountant #MomVsDaughter #CopyrightRevenge
thumb_text: MY DAUGHTER STOLE $1.1M, NOW SHE STUFFS MY ENVELOPES.
pinned_comment: What would you do if your daughter forged a rights-reversion letter, sold your memoir for $1.1 million, and mailed you a $5,000 check? Share your story in the comments.
